import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Modular {
        static class VarMod {
            static int value;
        }
        static int md = VarMod.value;

        int value;

        public Modular() {
            this.value = 0;
        }

        public Modular(int x) {
            this.value = normalize(x);
        }

        static int normalize(int x) {
            int mod = VarMod.value;
            int v = x % mod;
            if (v < 0) v += mod;
            return v;
        }

        public int get() {
            return value;
        }

        public Modular add(Modular other) {
            value = (value + other.value);
            if (value >= VarMod.value) value -= VarMod.value;
            return this;
        }

        public Modular sub(Modular other) {
            value = (value - other.value);
            if (value < 0) value += VarMod.value;
            return this;
        }

        public Modular mul(Modular other) {
            long x = (long) value * other.value;
            value = (int) (x % VarMod.value);
            if (value < 0) value += VarMod.value;
            return this;
        }

        public Modular inv() {
            return new Modular(modInverse(value, VarMod.value));
        }

        public Modular div(Modular other) {
            return mul(other.inv());
        }

        public Modular add(int x) {
            return add(new Modular(x));
        }

        public Modular sub(int x) {
            return sub(new Modular(x));
        }

        public Modular mul(int x) {
            return mul(new Modular(x));
        }

        public Modular div(int x) {
            return div(new Modular(x));
        }

        public Modular inc() {
            value++;
            if (value >= VarMod.value) value -= VarMod.value;
            return this;
        }

        public Modular dec() {
            value--;
            if (value < 0) value += VarMod.value;
            return this;
        }

        public Modular pow(int exp) {
            Modular base = new Modular(this.value);
            Modular res = new Modular(1);
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) res.mul(base);
                base.mul(base);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(value);
        }
    }

    static int modInverse(int a, int m) {
        int u = 0, v = 1;
        int mod = m;
        while (a != 0) {
            int t = mod / a;
            mod -= t * a;
            int temp = a;
            a = m;
            m = temp;
            u -= t * v;
            temp = u;
            u = v;
            v = temp;
        }
        if (mod != 1) return 0;
        return (u % m + m) % m;
    }

    static int n, m;
    static List<Modular> fact;
    static List<Modular> invFact;

    static Modular C(int x, int y) {
        int sz = Math.max(x, y);
        while (fact.size() < sz + 1) {
            int size = fact.size();
            fact.add(fact.get(size - 1).mul(size));
            invFact.add(new Modular(1).div(fact.get(size)));
        }
        if (y < 0 || y > x) return new Modular(0);
        return fact.get(x).mul(invFact.get(y)).mul(invFact.get(x - y));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        Modular.VarMod.value = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        fact = new ArrayList<>();
        invFact = new ArrayList<>();
        fact.add(new Modular(1));
        invFact.add(new Modular(1));

        Modular[] ptrDp = new Modular[m + 1];
        Modular[] ptrWays = new Modular[m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            ptrDp[i] = new Modular(0);
            ptrWays[i] = new Modular(0);
        }
        ptrWays[0] = new Modular(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
                int l = j, r = i - 1 - l;
                ptrWays[i] = ptrWays[i].add(ptrWays[l].mul(ptrWays[r]).mul(C(l + r, l)).mul(l + r + 2));
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
                int l = j, r = i - 1 - l;
                Modular add = new Modular(l).mul(l + 1).add(new Modular(r).mul(r + 1)).div(2);
                ptrDp[i] = ptrDp[i].add(ptrWays[l].mul(ptrWays[r]).mul(C(l + r, l)).mul(add));
                ptrDp[i] = ptrDp[i].add((ptrDp[l].mul(ptrWays[r]).add(ptrDp[r].mul(ptrWays[l]))).mul(C(l + r, r)).mul(l + r + 2));
            }
        }

        Modular[][] dp = new Modular[n + 1][m + 1];
        Modular[][] ways = new Modular[n + 1][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = new Modular(0);
                ways[i][j] = new Modular(0);
            }
        }
        ways[0][0] = new Modular(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= Math.min(m, i); ++s) {
                if (s == i) {
                    dp[i][s] = ptrDp[s];
                    ways[i][s] = ptrWays[s];
                    continue;
                }
                for (int d = 1; d <= s + 1; ++d) {
                    Modular ft = dp[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    Modular way = ways[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    int add = d - 1;
                    ways[i][s] = ways[i][s].add(way.mul(ptrWays[add]).mul(C(s, add)));
                    dp[i][s] = dp[i][s].add((way.mul(ptrDp[add]).add(ptrWays[add].mul(ft))).mul(C(s, add)));
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp[n][m].get());
    }
}
